kind: Manually reviewed primary sources; not a live discovery feed

candidates.name: Monero + P2Pool
candidates.decision: Best mechanism fit; pilot prerequisites unmet
candidates.upfront: No token purchase or stake; existing hardware required
candidates.work: CPU proof of work using a synced Monero node, P2Pool and an official miner
candidates.payment: XMR directly to receiving wallet when eligible pool shares receive block rewards
candidates.uncertainty: Share/block luck, electricity, hardware efficiency and conversion value. No guaranteed first-payment time.
candidates.next_step: Configure receiving wallet and official clients; run a bounded one-thread pilot.

candidates.name: Golem provider
candidates.upfront: Provider installation lists no token stake; cash-out gas is a separate cost
candidates.work: Rent CPU/RAM through official Yagna provider on x86-64 Linux/KVM
candidates.payment: GLM paid by requestors for agreed compute usage
candidates.uncertainty: Customer demand and provider selection remain. Windows/WSL setups are unsupported.
candidates.next_step: Check supported Linux/KVM environment and actual task demand before deployment.

candidates.name: Honeygain
candidates.decision: Optional service; does not remove demand uncertainty
candidates.upfront: Existing connection/device; account and payout terms required
candidates.work: Official client relays customer traffic through the connection
candidates.payment: Account credits subject to provider payout terms; no fixed traffic rate assumed
candidates.uncertainty: Demand varies by region. Sharing IP connectivity has practical consequences; no spoofed heartbeats.
candidates.next_step: Review current account/payout and connection-sharing terms before enabling.

candidates.name: Bittensor miner
candidates.upfront: Subnet registration charges TAO; cost and possible collateral vary
candidates.work: Compete under a specific subnet's scoring rules
candidates.payment: Performance-dependent emissions; registration and retention required
candidates.uncertainty: Entry cost, score competition, eviction and token value
candidates.next_step: Research only after a separately approved budget exists.

candidates.name: Nosana
candidates.upfront: Supported GPU plus current host/staking/transaction requirements must be verified
candidates.uncertainty: Available jobs, hardware compatibility, energy and current entry requirements
candidates.next_step: Do not budget or deploy until official host requirements and costs are verified.

candidates.name: Grass / Nodepay / DAWN / Gradient / Bless
candidates.decision: Research only; previous adapters were not integrations
candidates.work: Requires each project's official client, registration and rules
candidates.payment: No account credits, token receipts or fiat conversion evidenced in this workspace
candidates.uncertainty: Old prototype locally invented points and dollar exchange rates.
candidates.next_step: Assess each separately against the same evidence gate; points count as no demonstrated cash revenue.
